verdict.rationale: Docs reference the portable "Postman Collection format" used across the platform (design, CLI, Newman) and community evidence confirms collections can be exported/imported as JSON files to move between tools, and Newman/Postman CLI can run collections outside the GUI. However, no evidence pack item is an explicit dedicated import/export doc page, and a community comment (postman-comm-20) notes users have long wanted better sharing than manual export/import JSON files, suggesting the workflow is functional but clunky. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the export/import UI flow and format spec, plus independent confirmation of cross-tool compatibility (e.g. Insomnia/Newman import success).
